item.title: Why Omnicom IPG post-merger ‘account review’ buzz may be hiding a different client story
item.description: New Delhi: For Indian advertisers, the Omnicom-IPG merger is a two-sided coin: on one side is chatter about clients reviewing agency relationships, and on the other are the promised benefits of greater scale, deeper capabilities and more efficient delivery. In a conversation with BestMediaInfo.com, a top executive from the network said concerns around disruption are largely misplaced. item.title: Nitin Karkare takes over as Ulka Chairman after Omnicom–IPG merger
item.description: New Delhi: Nitin Karkare has been named Chairman of Ulka and Executive Director at Omnicom Advertising India as the company reorganises its leadership in the wake of the Omnicom–IPG merger. The integration has resulted in Ulka moving into the BBDO Group, following the retirement of the FCB brand. Karkare has spent the majority of his career at Ulka, having joined the agency in 1986 as a management trainee. item.title: Google clarifies it has ‘no plans’ to introduce ads to Gemini in 2026
item.description: New Delhi: Google has rejected claims that it is preparing to introduce advertisements into the Gemini app, following a report that suggested advertising clients had been informed of upcoming changes. A report published earlier stated that Google planned to bring ads to “its AI chatbot Gemini” in 2026, separate from the ads that currently appear in AI Mode and AI Overviews. item.title: Chupps and Into Creative ‘design for endings’ in new biodegradable Chupster campaign
item.description: New Delhi: Chupps Footwear has launched a new multimedia campaign for its 100% biodegradable Chupster range, created by Into Creative, that positions sustainability as “designing for endings” rather than a marginal add-on. item.title: NDTV to announce Indian of the Year 2025 winners on December 19
item.description: New Delhi: NDTV will reveal the winners of the Indian of the Year 2025 at a ceremony in New Delhi on December 19. The awards, now in their 20th year, recognise individuals whose ideas, achievements and influence have contributed to India’s evolving story. The 2025 edition follows the theme Ideas. Inspiration. item.title: Shemaroo to appeal order on Rs 70.26-crore GST ITC demand
item.description: New Delhi: Shemaroo Entertainment has received an order from the Commissioner (Appeals-II), CGST & Central Excise, Mumbai, in a case involving alleged inadmissible input tax credit (ITC) of Rs 70.26 crore and has said it will file a further appeal against the ruling. item.title: Nielsen audience segments now live on Amazon DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud
item.description: New Delhi: Nielsen has made its audience segments from Nielsen Marketing Cloud (NMC) available across the Amazon Ads marketplace, including Amazon DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud, giving advertisers a new way to use its data inside Amazon’s advertising ecosystem. item.title: Meta EU proposal to limit personal data for ads approved, avoids daily fines
item.description: New Delhi: Meta’s proposal to use less personal data for targeted advertising under its pay-or-consent model has received approval from European Union antitrust regulators, according to the news report. The model, set to be rolled out next month, means the company will not face the daily fines it could have incurred.
